content: SvelteKit file upload: form must have enctype=multipart/form-data when it contains file inputs. use:enhance works with multipart forms. Named action form: <form method=POST action=?/photo enctype=multipart/form-data use:enhance>. In server action, request.formData() returns FormData; file is accessed as formData.get('photo_file') which is a File object with .arrayBuffer() method. Use a dedicated named action (photo) separate from the main save action to avoid requiring multipart on the save form.
